description: Defines the TaskInfo class which encapsulates information about a running task attempt within Spark's scheduler, including timing, status, and resource details.

classes.name: TaskInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a task attempt in Spark, including identifiers, timing, status, and resource usage.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the TaskInfo instance.

methods.name: cloneWithEmptyAccumulables
methods.description: Creates a clone of the TaskInfo with empty accumulables.

methods.name: markGettingResult
methods.description: Records the time when the task started remotely fetching the result.

methods.name: markFinished
methods.description: Marks the task as finished with a specific state and time.

methods.name: launchSucceeded
methods.description: Marks the task as successfully launched.
